CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2836 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 54d588b56c25461b62bad742b9afe05b22eef62a. Bus nonce: 8cfa1ad27839646f6a493d1c0cf76aae. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 54d588b56c25461b62bad742b9afe05b22eef62a`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 54d588b56c25461b62bad742b9afe05b22eef62a` or `Fix review: blocked 54d588b56c25461b62bad742b9afe05b22eef62a <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8cfa1ad27839646f6a493d1c0cf76aae`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `54d588b56c25461b62bad742b9afe05b22eef62a` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2836 54d588b56c25461b62bad742b9afe05b22eef62a") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2836-8cfa1ad2`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA REVIEW of #2836 (R10-FLOW-RECORD-PITCH), round 2, head 54d588b56c25461b62bad742b9afe05b22eef62a. Thread: reviewer-2836, bus nonce 8cfa1ad27839646f6a493d1c0cf76aae. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA. Measure at the head; do not trust the body's figures.

ROUND 1 BLOCKED (the blocked verdict named the round-1 head) for carry-missing (carry 6, stamp flush). Ruling (orchestrator, 2026-10-25 21:19Z): the stamp flush goes in tools/release/stamp.py in THIS pull request, and step [7] never runs under a live train. Scope the delta to: (a) whether carry 6's stamp flush is now in stamp.py at the head and runs in the correct place; (b) whether [7] is correctly gated off under a live train; (c) the code diff since the round-1 head (the head the blocked verdict measured, named by its first line), read only inside the three-dot diff against origin/main. Other files merged in from origin/main are not this PR's changes.

ALSO CHECK EVERY CARRY of R10-FLOW-RECORD-PITCH below, item by item, against the head. The carries are quoted from the LIVE roster (dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster). A carry is answered only if implemented at the head or dismissed in the body with a reason and a destination.

GROUP BRIEF:
Records in the pitch (Lean study K6). In round 10, record pull requests were about half of every merge to main, and each one moves main under every open head. The record-autofix beat merges its own pull request whenever record_row.py --automerge-check passes and no young train-hold ref exists. Add a pitch bound to that automerge step: skip when the last record merge on main is younger than one pitch (3600 s), unless the oldest unrowed merge is older than two pitches (bounded staleness, so one record per merge stays the truth condition). The train's --bot-prs sweep then lands it inside the pitch. Land it where R10-CI-LAYOUT-P1 moves record-autofix off the Tests push run (its D-1), not in the old place. Controls: the step's harness shows a young record merge skips and a stale backlog proceeds; the existing train-hold arm is unchanged. Code-owned workflow: tvofi's review under the mandate.

CARRY 1 of 10:
Conditional: if the owner adopts GitHub's merge queue after R10-FLOW-MQ-PROBE, heads no longer absorb main and a record merge no longer stales them; close this group as not needed instead of building it.

CARRY 2 of 10:
Pre-study: the Lean flow pre-study, section K6.

CARRY 3 of 10:
HANDOVER trap 15 binds: one record per merge; batching the merge time, not the rows.

CARRY 4 of 10:
Self-test hygiene: (a) a new seat-selftest mutant in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py takes a per-file id (for example cloud_relay-1), never a new S number (the P6 convention), and sits inside the block of the instrument it tests, never appended at the file's end, so parallel additions touch different hunks; on 2026-10-21 three pull requests (R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD, R10-FLOW-YIELD-PROBE, R10-CI-LAYOUT's PR G) each lost a code round to a content conflict there when main gained tick_loop mutants S31-S34. (b) A self-test builds any git repository through tests/throwaway_git.py, never a hand-built git init (a pusher-reap handoff was refused for exactly that in tools/audit/seat/pr_args.sh); run python3 tests/throwaway_git.py --check before the handoff. (c) Any new git push site is registered in PUSHERS in tools/audit/seat/ref_privacy.py in the same pull request, or ref_privacy refuses it (#2582's heartbeat push did). (d) The body's Red checks section answers every check red on main's ancestry, one line each (today nightly-status), or pr-contract refuses it (standing rule 22).

CARRY 5 of 10:
tvofi 2026-10-24 card 4 (CARDS.json (prestudy-mech, r10s6 scratch, not in the tree)): confirmed held behind R10-FLOW-MQ-PROBE by this group's after-edge; the carry that says to close this group if the queue is adopted stands.

CARRY 6 of 10:
Record chain (triage: dev/programme/triage/s6-batch2.md#P49, merged at d2dcfed15a0c9d0bb4934f4b29cd95dbe04bbf44). Measure first whether a record-only merge owes a further row (plan record_row.py at main right after one: delivery/<N>.md of the merged record PR reading open, or the record check demanding a row for record/autofix merges). If it does, a record pull request's own merge must owe none: write its row final in the same pull request, or let the status cell open satisfy record for a record/autofix head, whichever the measurement shows is the cause. Controls: after a record-only merge the beat's plan prints nothing owed (null control: after a real rowless merge it prints that row); one mutant. HANDOVER trap 15 (one record per merge) stays true for real merges.

CARRY 7 of 10:
Batch record PRs (tvofi 2026-10-24: batch 4-5 entries). In .github/workflows/nightly.yml `record-autofix`, on a `push` event, open or update the record PR only when the plan (`record_row.py --plan`, counted with `--row-numbers`) holds at least 4 rowless merges, or the oldest rowless merge has at least 8 first-parent commits after it on main. That keeps a margin of 4 under `STALE_AFTER_COMMITS = 12` in tests/delivery_status.py, so batching never turns the record OVERDUE. `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch` runs flush at any count. How this combines with the pitch bound in this group's brief: this count and age gate decides when the record PR is opened or updated; the pitch decides when an already-open record PR automerges. Both stay. The pitch skip does not apply once the oldest rowless merge is 8 or more first-parent commits old (that arm overrides the pitch, as the brief's two-pitch arm does), so the opening wait and the automerge wait together stay under `STALE_AFTER_COMMITS`. The stamp step dispatches `record-autofix` and waits for its merge before tagging, because tools/release/stamp.py's rule 5 refuses rowless merges. Basis: 19 record merges on 2026-10-24 (UTC, first-parent at 0810d5b8f, `--grep='from tvofi/record/autofix'`) out of 46 merges that day, each costing a gate run, a `--bot-prs` sweep slot and a push to main that can force a train re-prove of about 30 to 45 min. All 19 row the previous record PR's own merge (the record chain P49 already carried here). Controls: a harness case where 3 rowless merges on a push open nothing (null: 4 open one, and a dispatch with 1 opens one); a case where an oldest merge 8 commits old opens at a count of 2; one mutant that drops the event check. A harness case where a young record merge would skip by the pitch but an oldest rowless merge 8 commits old proceeds. After merge, one UTC day's record merges by the same git rule against 2026-10-24's 19 (null: the rule run over the day before the merge reads at the old rate).

CARRY 8 of 10:
Owner directive (tvofi, 2026-10-25, orchestrator session): change the record-autofix workflow so record PRs batch many entries per PR, at least 8-10 delivery rows or kill records, instead of one PR per beat. Record PRs must never merge under a running train: they join the train queue / --bot-prs sweep only. Scope includes raising the record CI limit, meaning the per-run row cap, the beat's batch ceiling and any API-budget limit that caps how many rows one record run writes. Before choosing the number, assess whether batches can safely be larger than 10. Measure from round-10 history: rows per day, record PR size against review and CI time, the conflict rate of record PRs with each other and with trains, and the GitHub API budget per run (R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET's limits). State the safe maximum with numbers and a null control, set it, and pin it in the step's harness: one control where a batch below the floor waits, one where a full batch proceeds, and one where a stale backlog past the bounded-staleness limit proceeds regardless. Seam: this group owns the record-autofix job and record_row.py; R10-FLOW-MQ-PROBE owns tests.yml's merge_group handling.

CARRY 9 of 10:
Owner ruling (tvofi, 2026-10-25): record PRs need no review verdict, not even to enter the train. Today merge_train's --bot-prs sweep refuses a record PR at the approve step for lack of a "Fix review: merge <sha>" comment (s40 skipped #2796 for that reason). Change the train so a record PR (record/autofix branch, rows-only diff) is admitted on record_row.py --automerge-check alone, with no verdict and no approver comment, and merges inside the batch like any entry. Controls: a rows-only record PR with no verdict is admitted; a record-branch PR whose diff touches anything outside the delivery rows is refused (null: the guard must not admit a code change); one mutant per arm.

CARRY 10 of 10:
Resolved: the merge queue is not adopted in round 10 (tvofi 2026-10-25; #2826 closed). Take the train-path branch of the conditional; the hold behind R10-FLOW-MQ-PROBE is lifted.

Also check: the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2836.md is in the three-dot diff against origin/main; the merge with origin/main is clean (git merge-tree --write-tree); CI on this head from the check-runs API; and the mutation or failing-test proof the body names for the stamp flush.
